result.stdout:
docuoria — scaffold Docuoria AI skills into your AI-agent tool directories.

Usage:
  docuoria init   [path] [--tools <list>] [--delivery skills|commands|both] [--force] [--no-interactive]
  docuoria update [path]
  docuoria list-tools
  docuoria doctor
  docuoria license <status|set|acquire|offerings|buy|remove>
  docuoria version
  docuoria help

--tools  Comma-separated tool IDs (e.g. claude,cursor) or 'all'/'none'.
         Required when stdin is not a terminal or --no-interactive is given.
         Run 'docuoria list-tools' to see available IDs.
--force  Overwrite existing files that lack the Docuoria stamp.

result.stdout:
docuoria license — manage the Docuoria license key.

Usage:
  docuoria license status [--json]        Show license state, features, and usage.
  docuoria license set <key>              Store an encoded license credential.
  docuoria license acquire                Acquire a free license (sign in when prompted).
  docuoria license offerings              List what is available to buy.
  docuoria license buy --offering <id>    Purchase a specific offering.
  docuoria license remove                 Delete the stored license key.
